dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smoothly concave trailing edge forming a continuous spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Prominent convex arc with a large curvature radius defining the dorsal-anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity cyan-teal false-color gradient applied across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
